title: GP-VM x SMA: Benchmarking General-Purpose Vision Models and Specialized Architectures for 2D Medical Image Segmentation
mechanism: 11 segmenters (SegFormer, SegNeXt, TransNeXt, InternImage, medical-specific nets) under one protocol on 3 small 2D datasets, with linear mixed-effects models for significance.
evidence: R: general-purpose models comparable to or better than specialized ones (snippet: VW-MiT 91.0 mDSC, SegNeXt and SegFormer 90.7).
adaptation: Copy the mixed-effects analysis for our benchmark: fixed effect method, random effects fold, seed and source; addresses problem 5 (50-cell test noise).
min_experiment: Analysis only on existing and new CV results; no training.
